cohort: 605,362 deliveries across the five Nordic countries
finding: The incidence rate of emergency peripartum hysterectomy was 3.5/10,000 births, with Finland having the highest prevalence and Norway the lowest, and risk factors included previous cesarean section, preterm birth, and post-term birth.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the delivery mode in nearly 80% of emergency peripartum hysterectomy cases.
